column1: # Stage S5 X5 — the S5 switch: every consumer of the mission crates imports them directly, and the legacy `data::scenario`, `data::store` and `editing::tools::placement` re-export shims go. Paths name the tree before the moves.
# One row per module-prefix line of the S5 shim ledger, split per scope. Leaf-item rows of the
# `use` trees, `{self, …}` imports and prose spellings without a trailing `::` cannot be prefix
# rows and are rewritten by hand.
# mission_model: the ORBAT projection and the authored blocks
# mission_payload: the payload compiler and the kit alias table
# formation_geometry: the arrange vocabulary the editing tools re-exported, and its goldens
